description_en: Queries the storage overview information of an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster, such as the total data size, hot data size, cold data size, and data growth
description_zh: 查看实例的空间概览信息，包括总数据量、热数据量、冷数据量、数据增长量等
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-db-cluster-space-summary --db-cluster-id amv-wz9v5sa7mm79z4l2 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBClusterSpaceSummary

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Lakehouse Edition cluster
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">企业版、基础版或湖仓版的集群ID。</props>
<props="intl">湖仓版集群ID。</props>
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html接口查看支持的地域和可用区信息，包括地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

DataSize.description_en: The data size of table records. Unit: bytes

IndexSize.description_en: The data size of regular indexes. Unit: bytes

OtherSize.description_en: The data size of other data. Unit: bytes

PrimaryKeyIndexSize.description_en: The data size of primary key indexes. Unit: bytes

TotalSize.description_en:
The cold data size. Unit: bytes.

Formula: Cold data size = Data size of table records + Data size of regular indexes + Data size of primary key indexes + Data size of other data
TotalSize.description_zh:
冷数据总量，单位：Byte。

计算公式为：冷数据总量 = 表记录数据量 + 普通索引数据量 + 主键索引数据量 + 其他

DayGrowth.description_en:
The data growth within the last day. Unit: bytes.

Formula: Data growth within the last day = Current data size - Data size one day ago
DayGrowth.description_zh:
近1天增长量，单位：Byte。

计算公式为：近1天增长量 = 当前总数据量 - 1天前总数据量

WeekGrowth.description_en:
The daily data growth within the last seven days. Unit: bytes.

Formula: Daily data growth within the last seven days = (Current data size - Data size seven days ago)/7
WeekGrowth.description_zh:
近7天日均增长量，单位：Byte。

计算公式为：近7天日均增长量 = (当前总数据量 - 7天前总数据量) / 7

DataSize.description_en: The data size of table records. Unit: bytes

IndexSize.description_en: The data size of regular indexes. Unit: bytes

OtherSize.description_en: The data size of other data. Unit: bytes

PrimaryKeyIndexSize.description_en: The data size of primary key indexes. Unit: bytes

TotalSize.description_en:
The hot data size. Unit: bytes.

Formula: Hot data size = Data size of table records + Data size of regular indexes + Data size of primary key indexes + Data size of other data
TotalSize.description_zh:
热数据总量，单位：Byte。

计算公式为：热数据总量 = 表记录数据量 + 普通索引数据量 + 主键索引数据量 + 其他

TotalSize.description_en:
The total data size. Unit: bytes.

Formula: Total data size = Hot data size+ Cold data size
TotalSize.description_zh:
总数据量，单位：Byte。

计算公式为：总数据量 = 热数据总量 + 冷数据总量
